text.Claude Agent SDK로 Claude Code 에이전트를 실행합니: Runs Claude Code agents with the Claude Agent SDK.
text.에이전트 실행에 쓸 인증 방식입니다. 키·토큰은 비밀 참조(secret:: Authentication used to run agents. Write keys and tokens only as secret references (secret://name).
text.기본은 구독 로그인(Claude Code 로그인, 본인 책임)이고 API: The default is subscription sign-in (Claude Code sign-in, at your own responsibility); you can also pick an API key. Subscription must be allowed in the server administrator settings (allowed by default).
Change this to api_key to run with an API key instead of a subscription.
Key used with the API key method. Write it only as secret://name.
Change this to use a different API key or after you change the key.
text.구독 방식에서 쓸 토큰(secret://이름)입니다. 비우면 CLI 로그: Token used with the subscription method (secret://name). Leave empty to use the CLI sign-in.
Name of the environment variable that passes the API key.
Name of the environment variable that passes the subscription token.
text.Claude Agent SDK(에이전트 실행 도구)로 에이전트를 돌릴 때: Settings used when running agents with the Claude Agent SDK (the agent runner).
text.도구 사용 권한 모드입니다. 기본 dontAsk는 미리 허용한 것 밖을: Permission mode for tool use. The default dontAsk denies anything not allowed in advance.
text.미리 허용한 것만: Only what is allowed in advance
text.에이전트가 파일 수정 등을 묻지 않고 하게 하거나(acceptEdits): Change this to let the agent edit files and so on without asking (acceptEdits), or to have it ask every time.
text.읽을 Claude Code 설정 출처입니다. 기본은 project만 읽어: Claude Code settings sources to read. By default only project is read, so it doesn't mix with your personal settings.
text.내 Claude Code 개인 설정(user)도 함께 쓰고 싶을 때 바꾸: Change this to also use your personal Claude Code settings (user).
text.여기와 리소스로 준 MCP(외부 도구 서버)만 쓰고 다른 곳의 서버는 무: Uses only the MCP (external tool server) servers given here and through resources, and ignores servers from anywhere else.
Turn this off to also use servers registered separately in Claude Code.
text.직접 적는 MCP(외부 도구 서버) 설정입니다(이름 → 설정). 보통은: MCP (external tool server) settings written directly (name → settings). Usually you attach them as resources.
Fill this in to attach a server to this agent only, without making a resource.
text.쓸 수 있는 내장 도구입니다. 비우면 에이전트의 도구, claude_co: Built-in tools that can be used. Leave empty for the agent's tools; claude_code means all default tools.
text.Claude Code 기본 도구 전체(claude_code)를 쓰게 하고: Change this to allow all Claude Code default tools (claude_code).
Tool rules to allow without asking. Leave empty to use the agent's tools.
Fill this in to allow frequently used tools without asking every time.
Tool names to block in this execution backend.
Add tools here to block them in this execution backend.
Tool names to block when network access is not allowed.
Tool input names to check against the allowed command list.
Tool input names to check against the allowed folders.
text.권한을 물어야 하는데 답할 연결이 없을 때 거부(deny)할지 허용(al: Whether to deny (deny) or allow (allow) when permission must be asked but no edge can answer.
text.물을 곳 없는 권한 요청: Permission request with no one to ask
text.승인 연결 없이도 권한 요청을 허용해야 할 때만 allow로 바꾸세요(위: Change this to allow only when permission requests must be allowed without an approval edge (can be risky).
text.권한을 사용자에게 물을 수 있는 모드입니다. 이 모드면 승인 연결이 필요: Modes in which permission can be asked of the user. These modes need an approval edge.
Name of the tool that asks the user a question. Used only when there is a question edge.
text.에이전트 지침만 쓸지(custom) Claude Code 기본 지침 뒤에: Whether to use only the agent's instructions (custom) or append them after Claude Code's default instructions (claude_code_append).
text.Claude Code 기본에 덧붙이기: Append to the Claude Code default
text.Claude Code의 기본 도구 사용 요령을 함께 쓰고 싶을 때 cla: Change this to claude_code_append to also use Claude Code's default tool-use guidance.
Receives the text bit by bit while the answer is written and shows it on screen.
Turn this off if you don't need the text to appear bit by bit.
text.한 번 실행에서 모델이 주고받는 최대 횟수입니다. 비우면 제한이 없습니다: Maximum number of model exchanges in one run. Leave empty for no limit.
Lower this when the agent keeps calling tools and runs too long.
Cost limit for one run. Leave empty for no limit.
Set this to cap the cost of one run.
Model to use when the main model isn't available.
Set this when runs fail because the main model is busy or blocked.
text.모델이 얼마나 깊게 생각할지입니다(예: low, medium, high): How deeply the model thinks (e.g. low, medium, high).
Raise this if answers are shallow; lower it if runs are slow or expensive.
Extra folders it may read outside the allowed folders.
Add folders when the agent needs to read documents outside its run folder.
text.실행할 때 넣을 환경 변수입니다. 비밀 값은 secret://이름으로 적: Environment variables to set for the run. Write secret values as secret://name; they are masked in records.
Fill this in when a tool the agent uses needs environment variables (keys, tokens and so on).
text.쓸 Claude Code CLI 경로입니다. 비우면 함께 설치된 것을 씁: Path of the Claude Code CLI to use. Leave empty to use the one installed with it.
Fill this in to use another version of Claude Code that you installed yourself.
Passes Claude Code sandbox settings as is.
text.구독(기본, 본인 책임)이나 API 키 중 어떻게 로그인할지입니다. 칸을: How to sign in: subscription (default, at your own responsibility) or API key. When you open this field, subscription is the default and you can also pick an API key. Leave it out entirely to follow the environment variables and server policy.
Change this to choose whether to sign in with an API key or a subscription.
Also receives text written by subagents and shows it as that agent's messages.
Name of the delegation tool to add when there are subagents.
Tool names to recognize as delegation calls.
Name of the MCP (external tool server) server that holds platform tools such as the delegation tool. It must not clash with other servers.
Change this only if you get an error that it clashes with another server name.
text.서브에이전트 도구 규칙을 위임자에게도 미리 허용합니다. 넓어지므로 기본은: Also allows the subagents' tool rules for the delegator in advance. This widens permissions, so it's off by default.
text.서브에이전트가 있을 때 넣는 환경 변수입니다. 환경 변수에 같은 키가 있: Environment variables set when there are subagents. If the environment variables have the same key, that value wins.
text.붙인 파일 목록을 지침 끝에 알릴 문구입니다({files}). 비우면 붙: Text that lists attached files at the end of the instructions ({files}). Leave empty to leave it out.
text.skill을 부르는 도구 이름입니다. skill을 붙이면 자동으로 더합니: Name of the tool that calls skills. Added automatically when skills are attached.
Name format of skills in the bundle ({plugin}, {skill}).
text.경로 조건 규칙을 지침에 붙일지(instructions) 규칙 파일로 둘: Whether to append path-conditioned rules to the instructions (instructions) or keep them as rule files (files).
Environment variables set when rules are delivered as files.
text.명령형 hook을 실행 범위 검사 뒤 돌릴지(callback) CLI가: Whether command hooks run after the run scope checks (callback) or are run by the CLI directly (settings).
text.hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령)에 시간 제한을 적지 않았을 때 쓰: Value used when a hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) doesn't set a time limit.
Raise this when hook commands take long and get cut off.
text.위에 없는 Claude Agent SDK(에이전트 실행 라이브러리) 옵션: Passes Claude Agent SDK (agent runner library) options not listed above, by their exact names.
Use this only when you really need an option not listed above.
text.설치자 설정 backends.claude-agent-sdk.allow_c: Command hooks don't run because the server administrator setting backends.claude-agent-sdk.allow_command_hooks is off
text.MCP 서버 상태와 MCP 도구 호출 시작·완료(소요 시간·오류)를 mc: Records MCP server status and the start and end of MCP tool calls (duration, errors) as mcp.* events.
text.MCP(외부 도구 서버) 도구 호출을 기록합니다. 지금은 따로 정할 항목: Records MCP (external tool server) tool calls. There is nothing to set for now.
text.SDK 관찰 훅 콜백과 CLI 설정 hook 실행을 hook.* 이벤트로: Records SDK observation hook callbacks and CLI settings hook runs as hook.* events.
text.에이전트 실행 중 hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령) 이벤트를 기록할: Settings for recording hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) events during an agent run.
text.기록할 hook(도구 실행 전후에 도는 명령) 이벤트 이름입니다(예: P: Names of the hook (a command that runs before or after a tool) events to record (e.g. PreToolUse, Stop).
text.아주 짧은 요청 한 번을 실제로 보냅니다. API 키 방식이면 소량의 A: Actually sends one very short request. With an API key it costs a small API fee; with a subscription it uses a little subscription usage.
text.Claude Code의 구독 로그인(claude auth login)을: Runs the Claude Code subscription sign-in (claude auth login) in the app. Claude Code stores the sign-in in its own location; the app doesn't keep it.
text.본인 구독, 본인 책임: Anthropic 문서상 Agent SDK 기반: Your subscription, your responsibility: Anthropic's documentation recommends API keys for apps built on the Agent SDK, and using a subscription sign-in is at your own responsibility. To sign out, use the … menu on the status card or run claude auth logout in a terminal.
text.앱 전용 자격 폴더(앱 작업 공간 안)입니다. 모든 프로젝트가 이 로그인: This is the app's own credentials folder (inside the app workspace). All projects share this one sign-in, and it's stored separately from the terminal Claude Code (~/.claude) sign-in
text.로그인 필요 — 앱 전용 자격 폴더에 구독 로그인 정보가 없습니다: Sign-in required — the app's credentials folder has no subscription sign-in
text.앱 작업 공간의 자격 폴더에 구독 로그인 정보가 없습니다. [구독으로 로: The credentials folder in the app workspace has no subscription sign-in. Select [Sign in with subscription] to store one in this folder for all projects to share. The terminal ~/.claude sign-in isn't used.
text.키 없음 — API 키가 설정되지 않았습니다: No key — no API key is set
text.구독 방식 꺼짐 — 설치자 설정에서 켜야 합니다: Subscription off — turn it on in the server administrator settings
text.Anthropic 문서는 Agent SDK 기반 앱에 API 키 사용을: Anthropic's documentation recommends API keys for apps built on the Agent SDK. To use your own subscription sign-in, turn on allow_subscription_auth in the server administrator settings (at your own responsibility).
text.본인 Claude Code 구독 로그인으로 실행합니다. Anthropic: Runs with your own Claude Code subscription sign-in. Anthropic's documentation recommends API keys for apps built on the Agent SDK, and using a subscription sign-in is at your own responsibility.
text.로그인 파일을 찾지 못했습니다. 터미널에서 claude를 실행해 로그인했: Couldn't find the sign-in file. Run claude in a terminal and check that you're signed in. If the sign-in is stored in the operating system keychain, it can work without the file.
text.구독 토큰 없음 — 토큰이 설정되지 않았습니다: No subscription token — no token is set
text.Claude Agent SDK가 쓸 Claude Code 실행 파일을 찾: Couldn't find the Claude Code executable that the Claude Agent SDK uses. Install Claude Code, or set the executable path (readiness.cli_path) in the server administrator settings.
text.설정 값에 직접 적힘(비밀 참조를 권장합니다): Written directly in the settings value (a secret reference is recommended)
Not tested because no key is set.
Not tested because the subscription method is off.
Not tested because the Claude Code executable wasn't found.
Authentication failed. Check the API key or sign-in.
Couldn't connect to Claude. Check the network connection.
An error occurred during the connection test.
text.API 키 넣는 곳 보기: Show where to set the API key
text.터미널의 Claude Code도 같은 로그인을 씁니다: Claude Code in the terminal uses the same sign-in
text.브라우저에서 로그인하세요. 창이 열리지 않았으면 [로그인 페이지 열기]를: Sign in in the browser. If no window opened, select [Open sign-in page].
If the browser shows a code, paste it.
Sent the code. Waiting for confirmation.
text.Claude Code가 오류를 알렸습니다. 아래 CLI 화면을 확인하고: Claude Code reported an error. Check the CLI screen below and try again.
Couldn't find the Claude Code executable.
Sign-in from the app isn't available in this environment (no terminal connection).
Claude Code exited before the sign-in finished.
Couldn't confirm the sign-in. Try again.
text.앱 화면 로그인을 쓰려면 선택 기능을 설치하세요: pip install: To sign in from the app, install the optional feature: pip install 'agent-console-backend-claude-sdk[login]'. Until then, sign in from a terminal with claude auth login.
Signed out. The Claude Code sign-in on this PC was removed.
Signed out. The sign-in in the app's credentials folder was removed.
text.자격 폴더를 준비하지 못했습니다. 폴더 권한과 설치자 설정 auth_di: Couldn't prepare the credentials folder. Check the folder permissions and the server administrator setting auth_dir.config_dir.
Couldn't sign out because the Claude Code executable wasn't found.
text.비밀 '{name}'을(를) 찾지 못했습니다. 환경 변수나 비밀 저장소에: Secret “{name}” wasn't found. Put the key in an environment variable or the secret store, then check again.
text.자격 폴더 권한을 좁히지 못했습니다({names}). 이 파일 시스템이: Couldn't restrict the credentials folder permissions ({names}). This file system may not support permissions, so make sure other users can't read this location.
text.서버 환경에 {name}이(가) 설정돼 있습니다. 앱 실행에는 쓰지 않지: {name} is set in the server environment. The app doesn't use it for runs, but in the terminal Claude Code it takes priority over this sign-in.

codes.agent_error: The agent ended with an error.
codes.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check the API key or sign-in.
codes.auth_missing: No key or token is set.
codes.backend.auth_dir_unavailable: Couldn't create or open the app's credentials folder. Check the folder permissions.
codes.backend.subscription_auth_disabled: Anthropic's documentation recommends API keys for apps built on the Agent SDK. To use your own subscription, turn on allow_subscription_auth in the server administrator settings (at your own responsibility).
codes.backend.subscription_auth_enabled: Runs with your own Claude Code subscription sign-in, as allowed by the server administrator setting allow_subscription_auth. Anthropic's documentation recommends API keys for apps built on the Agent SDK, and using a subscription is at your own responsibility.
codes.backend_error: The execution backend reported an error.
codes.backend_no_result: The execution backend ended without a result.
codes.cli_missing: Couldn't find the Claude Code executable.
codes.exited: Claude Code exited before sign-in finished.
codes.network: Couldn't connect to Claude. Check the network connection.
codes.observe.collector_config_invalid: The settings of observation collector {collector} are invalid.
codes.observe.hook_probe_wrapped: hook wrapping is on: {hooks} hook commands are wrapped with the hook probe to record input, output, decision and duration.
codes.observe.unknown_collector: Observation collector {collector} isn't available for backend {backend}, so nothing is recorded.
codes.pty_unavailable: In-app sign-in isn't available in this environment (no terminal connection).
codes.secret_unresolved: Couldn't resolve a secret reference. Check the secret name and store.
codes.verify_failed: Couldn't confirm the sign-in. Try again.
